entries.event: The US announced a 46% reciprocal tariff on Vietnamese goods and VN-Index suffered its biggest daily fall on record.
entries.move: VN-Index -6.68% (-88 points) to below 1,230 on Apr 3, 2025
entries.moveQuote: VN-Index đóng cửa với mức giảm 88 điểm (-6,68%) qua đó lùi xuống dưới 1.230 điểm. (VN-Index closed down 88 points, -6.68%, falling below 1,230.)
entries.lesson: Vietnam's export-driven market sells off hard on US trade threats.
entries.note: Figure confirmed (-6.68%, analogs.ts says ~6.7%). Later parts (Apr 9 low, Apr 10 rebound) moved to separate verified entries; the rebound is +6.77% at the close, not ~6.8% from this page.

entries.event: After the 46% tariff announcement VN-Index fell four sessions in a row to its lowest since Nov 2023, with margin-call forced selling cited.
entries.move: VN-Index -224 points (-17%) over four sessions; Apr 9 close 1,094.3 (-3.4%)
entries.moveQuote: VN-Index mất gần 224 điểm (-17%) rơi về mức thấp nhất kể từ tháng 11/2023. (VN-Index lost nearly 224 points, -17%, to its lowest since Nov 2023.) And on Apr 9: Đóng cửa phiên giao dịch, VN-Index giảm 38,49 điểm (3,4%) xuống 1.094,3 điểm.
entries.lesson: A trade shock can take a market down about 17% in four sessions, and the move can reverse in a day when policy changes.
entries.note: Apr 9 quote from https://cafef.vn/vn-index-van-giam-gan-40-diem-co-phieu-ho-vin-tro-thanh-diem-sang-188250409171903577.chn (that page does not mention margin calls; do not cite margin calls from it).

entries.event: The US paused reciprocal tariffs for 90 days and VN-Index posted its biggest one-day gain on record.
entries.move: VN-Index +6.77% (+74 points) to 1,168.34 on Apr 10, 2025
entries.moveQuote: Chứng khoán đóng cửa ở 1.168,34 điểm. Tính theo điểm số tương đối, VN-Index tích lũy 6,77% (The market closed at 1,168.34; up 6.77% in relative terms.)
entries.lesson: Headline-driven crashes can reverse as fast as they fell, but one rebound day does not erase the damage.
entries.note: The 'biggest gain in history' wording is from cafef (+6.62% right after ATO, intraday): https://cafef.vn/chung-khoan-viet-nam-tang-manh-nhat-lich-su-sau-thong-bao-tam-dung-ap-thue-doi-ung-cua-ong-trump-188250410095250381.chn

entries.event: President Trump said the US would cut tariffs on Vietnamese goods significantly after a call with Vietnam's leader; the market rose most of the day then closed slightly lower.
entries.move: VN-Index -2.63 points to 1,381.96 on Jul 3, 2025 (small fall after an intraday gain)
entries.moveQuote: Kết thúc phiên 3/7, VN-Index giảm 2,63 điểm, xuống 1.381,96 điểm. (At the close on Jul 3, VN-Index fell 2.63 points to 1,381.96.) ... áp lực chốt lời xuất hiện vào cuối giờ chiều đã khiến chỉ số quay đầu giảm. (late-afternoon profit-taking pushed the index down.)
entries.lesson: When good trade news is already expected, a deal framework without numbers can fade into profit-taking.
entries.note: Article says the deal was only a framework and gave no specific tariff rates.

entries.event: VN-Index closed back above 1,500 on record-scale liquidity, its highest in over three years.
entries.move: VN-Index +1.65% (+24.49 points) to 1,509.54 on Jul 22, 2025
entries.moveQuote: VN-Index tăng 24,49 điểm (1,65%) lên mức 1.509,54 điểm (VN-Index rose 24.49 points, 1.65%, to 1,509.54)
entries.lesson: Rallies to old highs usually come with high liquidity and broad blue-chip buying; check both.
entries.note: Page says the close was the highest in over three years (since Apr 6, 2022) and does not claim it was the first ever close above 1,500.

entries.event: The new KRX trading system went live on HoSE after more than 10 years of preparation.
entries.move: VN-Index up almost 14 points to about 1,240 on May 5, 2025
entries.moveQuote: Điều này thể hiện qua việc chỉ số VN-Index tăng gần 14 điểm so với tham chiếu, đóng cửa tại 1.240 điểm. (VN-Index rose almost 14 points from reference, closing at 1,240.)
entries.lesson: Infrastructure upgrades like KRX are slow-burn positives; the day-one move was modest and liquidity stayed low.
entries.note: The exact 13.75 points / 1.12% comes from a search result summary of a cafef/tuoitre page and was not independently opened; the opened page says almost 14 points to 1,240. [Edited in review: claim not on an opened page removed.]

entries.event: Covid-19 and the oil price war hit Vietnam's market, with its largest one-day fall in 19 years on Mar 9.
entries.move: VN-Index -6.28% on Mar 9, 2020; -130 points (nearly -15%) in the week to Mar 13, closing at 761
entries.moveQuote: VN-Index ngày 9/3 giảm 6,28% ... VN-Index giảm 130 điểm, tương đương gần 15% ... xuống còn 761 điểm (the week's loss, close 761)
entries.lesson: Pandemic panic hits Vietnam hard and fast, and the first week is not the bottom (low came in late March).
entries.note: March 2020 full month -24.9% and Q1 -31.06% (close 662.53) verified at https://cafef.vn/chung-khoan-viet-nam-giam-31-trong-quy-1-thiet-lap-hang-loat-ky-luc-buon-cho-nha-dau-tu-20200331165612893.chn : 'Trong tháng 3/2020, chỉ số VN-Index có mức giảm lên tới 24,9%'. The 'biggest in 19 years' wording is from the same vnexpress page.

entries.event: VN-Index set a record above 1,200 in early April 2018, then gave up the gains over the rest of the year.
entries.move: VN-Index fell more than 25% from the April peak to 892.54 on Dec 28, 2018
entries.moveQuote: Chốt phiên giao dịch cuối cùng của năm 2018, VN-Index giảm 8,27 điểm (tương đương 0,92%) lùi về ngưỡng 892,54 điểm ... Relative to the April peak the article says it fell 'hơn 25%' (more than 25%).
entries.lesson: Record highs after a very strong quarter can be followed by months of decline when global conditions turn.
entries.note: Peak date: vnexpress says only 'early April'; cafef calls it ~1,200 (about 25% correction). Exact 1,204 and Apr 9 not verified from opened pages.

entries.event: VN-Index hit its all-time high on Jan 6, 2022 then fell to a two-year low in mid-November amid bond stress and a wave of margin calls.
entries.move: VN-Index from 1,528.57 (Jan 6, 2022) to an intraday low of 874; Nov 15 close 911.9 (-3.1% that day)
entries.moveQuote: Thậm chí, chỉ số có thời điểm đã nhúng xuống 874 điểm trước khi hồi phục và giao dịch cân bằng quanh ngưỡng 1.000 điểm. Đà giảm càng trở nên 'khốc liệt' khi làn sóng call margin lan rộng. (The index dipped to 874 before recovering; the fall became fierce as the margin-call wave spread.)
entries.lesson: Record margin debt (over 200,000 billion VND then) turns a correction into forced selling and repeated limit-down sessions.
entries.note: Peak 1,528.57 on Jan 6, 2022 from https://cafef.vn/ngay-nay-2-nam-truoc-vn-index-lap-dinh-lich-su-152857-diem-188240105233819823.chn. Percent fall from peak to 874 (about -43%) is my calculation, not stated by the source.

entries.event: Vietnam corporate bond freeze after Van Thinh Phat chair Truong My Lan was arrested on Oct 8, 2022; VN-Index hit a 25-month closing low on Nov 15.
entries.move: VN-Index -3.1% to 911.9 on Nov 15, 2022; -116 points (-11.3%) from the start of November
entries.moveQuote: VN-Index đóng cửa giảm 3,1% xuống 911,9 điểm, thấp nhất trong hơn 25 tháng kể từ ngày 5/10/2020. Tính từ đầu tháng 11, VN-Index đã mất thêm 116 điểm, tương ứng mức giảm 11,3%.
entries.lesson: Credit and bond stress in Vietnam hits real estate, banks and brokers through margin calls; forced selling tends to overshoot.
entries.note: The original vnexpress source only reports the arrest (Oct 8) and no market figure. Replaced with the cafef Nov 15 page. The old claims '~12% from Oct 7' and '-19% from Sep 30' are NOT in either page and should be dropped; use -11.3% since Nov 1 and Nov 15 close 911.9. Arrest source: https://vnexpress.net/chu-tich-tap-doan-van-thinh-phat-truong-my-lan-bi-bat-4520410.html ('Ngày 8/10, bà Lan, 66 tuổi, bị ... khởi tố, bắt tạm giam').

entries.event: The State Bank of Vietnam raised policy rates by 1 percentage point, its first hike since May 2011, as the dong came under pressure from the strong dollar.
entries.move: Policy rates +1 percentage point; dong lost about 4% against USD in the first nine months of 2022
entries.moveQuote: Từ ngày 23/9, NHNN đã tăng các loạt lãi suất điều hành và trần lãi suất tiền gửi dưới 6 tháng thêm 1 điểm %. ... đây là lần đầu tiên cơ quan quản lý tiền tệ nâng lãi suất điều hành kể từ tháng 5/2011. (From Sep 23 SBV raised policy rates and the under-6-month deposit cap by 1 point; first hike since May 2011.)
entries.lesson: When the Fed tightens, Vietnam's central bank defends the dong with rates and dollar sales, which tightens credit for property and brokers.
entries.note: The ~4% VND loss is stated in the same article ('trong 9 tháng đầu năm, VND mất khoảng 4%'); it is a measured YTD move, not a one-day move.

entries.event: The State Bank of Vietnam cut its operating rates by 1 percentage point, the first cut in about two years.
entries.move: Rediscount rate 4.5% to 3.5%; overnight lending rate 7% to 6%; deposit-rate cap unchanged
entries.moveQuote: Ngân hàng Nhà nước cuối ngày 14/3 thông báo giảm 1% các loại lãi suất điều hành. Mức lãi suất mới có hiệu lực từ ngày mai (15/3). (SBV announced a 1% cut in operating rates; new rates effective Mar 15.)
entries.lesson: A policy-rate cut signals easier credit, but the refinancing rate (6%) and deposit caps were unchanged, so effects on markets come slowly.
entries.note: No VN-Index move recorded for this event; entry is a policy-rate change, not a price move. 'First cut in about two years' is from a tuoitre search result, not from the opened page.

entries.event: Covid-19 panic and a US travel ban from Europe produced the S&P 500's worst day since 1987.
entries.moveQuote: Cuối phiên, S&P 500 giảm 9,5%, mức giảm tồi tệ nhất kể từ ngày Thứ 2 đen tối năm 1987. (At the close, S&P 500 fell 9.5%, the worst since Black Monday 1987.)
entries.lesson: Pandemic fear can drive record one-day falls; circuit breakers halt trading but do not stop the slide.
entries.note: The 'travel ban' cause is my context, not from the opened page.

entries.event: The Fed made an emergency 0.5 percentage point rate cut over Covid-19, but stocks still fell.
entries.move: Dow Jones -786 points (about -3%) to 25,917; S&P 500 -2.8% on Mar 3, 2020
entries.moveQuote: chỉ số công nghiệp Dow Jones giảm gần 786 điểm, tương đương gần 3%, xuống 25.917 điểm ... S&P 500 giảm 2,8% (Dow fell nearly 786 points, almost 3%, to 25,917; S&P 500 fell 2.8%)
entries.lesson: A surprise emergency cut can read as a sign of crisis rather than relief.
entries.note: Page is dated Mar 4, 2020 and reports the Mar 3 session; Fed cut size 0.5% from the same page.

entries.event: Talks between OPEC and Russia collapsed and Saudi Arabia started a price war, sending oil sharply lower.
entries.move: Brent -20.76% to $35.87 and WTI -20.52% to $32.87 (intraday, Mar 9, 2020)
entries.moveQuote: Dầu Brent hiện mất 20,76% về 35,87 USD một thùng. Dầu WTI giảm 20,52% xuống 32,87 USD. (Brent is down 20.76% to $35.87; WTI down 20.52% to $32.87.)
entries.lesson: A supply fight on top of falling demand can cut oil about 20% in a day and drag energy stocks and the whole market.
entries.note: Intraday figure (live blog during the session), not a close. Cafef says Brent lost up to 31% at the worst but the page does not date it explicitly.

entries.event: WTI May futures turned negative for the first time because demand collapsed and storage filled up.
entries.move: WTI May contract closed at -$37.63 a barrel on Apr 20, 2020 (previous Friday: $18.27)
entries.moveQuote: Chốt phiên, mỗi thùng dầu loại này chỉ còn âm 37,63 USD (At the close, a barrel of this oil was at minus $37.63.) ... đóng cửa tuần trước ở 18,27 USD (prior close $18.27)
entries.lesson: Expiring futures can price far below spot demand when storage is full; the longer-dated contracts barely moved.
entries.note: The $18.27 prior close came from a second fetch of a vnexpress article with the same ID; the $55.90 drop is my arithmetic.

entries.event: OPEC decided to keep output unchanged and oil fell to its lowest in over five years, starting the 2014-16 collapse.
entries.move: US crude $68.11 and Brent $71.58, about -8% in the immediate aftermath; about -34% since June
entries.moveQuote: Giá dầu thô của Mỹ chỉ còn ở mức 68,11 USD/thùng trong khi giá dầu Brent Biển Bắc ở Anh chỉ ở mức 71,58 USD/thùng. ... đã giảm xấp xỉ 34% và riêng trong tháng 11 giảm 13% (US crude $68.11, Brent $71.58; down about 34% since June and 13% in November alone.)
entries.lesson: When a producer cartel stops defending prices, oil can fall by a third in months; producers and exporters suffer, importers gain.
entries.note: The '8% in the aftermath' is a summary of the article by the fetch tool, not a verbatim sentence; the 34% and 13% figures are quoted. Page is dated Nov 30, 2014.

entries.event: Brent climbed to a multi-year high as the West weighed sanctions on Russian energy after the invasion of Ukraine.
entries.move: Brent +6.1% intraday to $119.84, highest since May 2012 (Mar 3, 2022)
entries.moveQuote: Giá dầu Brent chiều nay có thời điểm tăng 6,1%, chạm 119,84 USD một thùng – cao nhất kể từ tháng 5/2012. (Brent at one point rose 6.1% to $119.84, the highest since May 2012.)
entries.lesson: War with a major energy exporter lifts oil, gas and inflation expectations; the peak is often a spike, not a trend.
entries.note: Intraday. Page title says 14-year high but body says highest since May 2012; the $139 peak (Mar 7) was not confirmed from an opened page.

entries.event: OPEC+ announced a surprise output cut of about 1.16 million barrels a day from May.
entries.move: Crude rose by more than $4 a barrel on Apr 3, 2023
entries.moveQuote: Giá dầu thô đã tăng hơn 4 USD/thùng vào thứ Hai (3/4). (Crude oil rose by more than $4 a barrel on Monday, Apr 3.)
entries.lesson: Surprise supply cuts push oil and inflation expectations up and can keep interest rates higher for longer.
entries.note: Page gives dollars, not percent; do not state a percent. Cut size 1.16 million bpd from the same page.

entries.event: After Hamas attacked Israel on Oct 7, oil and gold rose on the first trading day.
entries.move: WTI +4.3% to $86, Brent +4.2% to $88, gold +$28 to $1,861 (Oct 9, 2023 close)
entries.moveQuote: Dầu WTI tăng 4,3%, còn Brent tăng 4,2%, lên lần lượt 86 USD và 88 USD một thùng. ... mỗi ounce vàng tăng gần 28 USD, lên 1.861 USD (WTI +4.3%, Brent +4.2%; gold up nearly $28 to $1,861.)
entries.lesson: Regional conflicts lift oil and gold at first; the move fades unless supply is actually hit.
entries.note: Oil's biggest one-day gain in six months per the same page.

entries.event: Israel launched strikes on Iran, causing a jump in oil and gold.
entries.move: Brent about +11% to $77 and WTI +10.8% to $75.3 (intraday, Jun 13, 2025); spot gold +$54 to $3,437
entries.moveQuote: Dầu Brent hiện tăng 11% lên 77 USD một thùng. Dầu WTI tăng 10,8% lên 75,3 USD. (Brent is now up 11% to $77; WTI up 10.8% to $75.3.) ... Giá vàng thế giới giao ngay tăng gần 54 USD lên 3.437 USD.
entries.lesson: Strikes near the Gulf send oil up sharply on supply fear; the closing gain was smaller than the intraday peak.
entries.note: Intraday live figures. A search summary gave Brent close +7.02% to $74.23 but I did not open that page, so do not cite it.

entries.event: Houthi attacks in the Red Sea forced ships to detour around Africa instead of using the Suez Canal.
entries.move: Asia-Europe container freight more than doubled vs the 2023 average to $3,500 per 40-foot container; fuel costs up to $2 million more per Suez-avoiding trip
entries.moveQuote: Giá cước từ châu Á đến châu Âu đã tăng hơn gấp đôi so với trung bình năm 2023 ... lên đến 3.500 USD cho mỗi container 40 feet. (Asia-Europe rates more than doubled from the 2023 average to $3,500 per 40ft container.)
entries.lesson: Shipping chokepoint attacks raise freight costs and delivery times, hitting exporters like Vietnam before they hit stock indexes.
entries.note: Page's date not stated in fetch; it is a Jan 2024 article (ID 4697840). Freight is a shipping rate, not a market index move.

entries.event: Britain voted to leave the EU, causing a global sell-off and a record drop in sterling.
entries.move: Nikkei -7.9%, DAX -6.8%, CAC 40 -8%, FTSE 100 -3.15%, sterling -8% vs USD (closes, Jun 24, 2016)
entries.moveQuote: Mạnh nhất là Nhật Bản, khi chỉ số Nikkei 225 chốt phiên mất 7,9%. ... FTSE 100 chỉ mất 3,15%. ... Bảng Anh cũng có ngày mất giá mạnh nhất lịch sử, khi giảm hơn 8% so với USD. (Nikkei lost 7.9% at the close; FTSE 100 lost just 3.15%; sterling had its worst day ever, down more than 8% vs the dollar.)
entries.lesson: A political surprise hits currency and risk assets together, but the damage differs by market (Japan and Germany fell more than the FTSE).
entries.note: The DAX/CAC closing figures appear as 'DAX và CAC 40 giảm 6,8% và 8%' on the same page; sterling's intraday low was about -10%.

entries.event: China's stock market crash of mid-2015: more than 1,300 firms halted trading to limit the slide.
entries.move: Shanghai Composite lost about one-third of its value since mid-June; as much as -8.2% at the open on Jul 8, 2015 (intraday); up as much as 5.76% the next session
entries.moveQuote: cổ phiếu tại sàn Thượng Hải đã mất một phần ba giá trị từ giữa tháng 6 (Shanghai shares had lost one third of their value since mid-June) ... Đầu phiên, Shanghai Composite Index mất tới 8,2% - mạnh nhất từ năm 2007.
entries.lesson: Leveraged retail-driven rallies in China can unwind by a third in weeks, and trading halts do not stop the fall.
entries.note: The Aug 24, 2015 'Black Monday' and Jan 2016 circuit-breaker figures were not verified (Wikipedia unreachable). 8.2% is intraday.

entries.event: Fear that China's Evergrande would default on its debts triggered a global equity sell-off.
entries.move: S&P 500 -1.7% (worst session since May) and Hang Seng -3.3% (lowest close since Oct 2020) on Sep 20, 2021
entries.moveQuote: S&P 500 vừa ghi nhận phiên giao dịch tồi tệ nhất kể từ tháng 5 khi mất 1,7% trong phiên 20/9. ... Chỉ số Hang Seng của thị trường Hong Kong giảm 3,3%, đóng cửa thấp nhất kể từ tháng 10/2020
entries.lesson: A property-developer debt scare in China spreads to world markets but a contained one can fade within weeks.
entries.note: Dow close (-1.78%) from search summary was not confirmed on the opened page.

entries.event: Nikkei suffered its worst day since 1987 after a weak US jobs report and the BOJ's rate hike and yen surge.
entries.moveQuote: Nikkei 225 chốt phiên giảm 12,4% xuống còn 31.458,42 điểm (Nikkei 225 closed down 12.4% to 31,458.42.)
entries.lesson: Carry-trade unwinds can cause record falls, followed by a quick rebound; cafef headline gives 13.47%, so sources differ.
entries.note: Page shows both 12.4% (text) and 13.47% (a linked headline, same page). Use 12.4%. The Aug 6 rebound (+10.2%) was not verified since vietstock is blocked in this session.

entries.event: The SEC approved spot Bitcoin ETFs on Jan 10, 2024 and they began trading Jan 11; Bitcoin sold off after the launch.
entries.move: Bitcoin rose to about $49,000, fell back to $46,000 the same day, then -10% to $41,500 in the next 24 hours
entries.moveQuote: đẩy giá Bitcoin lên 49.000 USD ... rơi về 46.000 USD cùng ngày. ... Bitcoin giảm 10% xuống 41.500 USD khi chứng kiến đợt bán tháo ồ ạt. (pushed Bitcoin to $49,000; fell back to $46,000 the same day; down 10% to $41,500 amid heavy selling.)
entries.lesson: A long-awaited approval can be a 'sell the news' event; the first-day high did not hold.
entries.note: Prices are intraday quotes from the article, not daily closes.

entries.event: Spot gold passed $4,000 an ounce for the first time ever.
entries.move: Spot gold above $4,000 on Oct 8, 2025; +52% since the start of the year
entries.moveQuote: Sáng 8/10, giá vàng thế giới giao ngay vượt 4.000 USD một ounce lần đầu tiên trong lịch sử. ... Từ đầu năm, giá giao ngay đã tăng 52%. (On Oct 8, spot gold rose above $4,000 for the first time; up 52% since the start of the year.)
entries.lesson: Record gold runs are driven by haven demand and central-bank buying, but they can pull back sharply from the peak.
entries.note: Pullback below $4,000 on Oct 27 and peak $4,381 on Oct 20 are from a search summary only, not verified.
